newsitem.title: USA: E-Z Serve sells gasoline retail unit.
newsitem.headline: E-Z Serve sells gasoline retail unit.

text.p: E-Z Serve Corp said Wednesday it was selling all of the capital stock of its unit, E-Z Serve Petroleum Marketing Co, to Restructure Inc, an affiliate of Tampa, Fla.,-based Environmental Corporation of America Inc, for $451,278.
In a stock purchase agreement, E-Z Serve said it would collect the payment throughout 1997 and use the proceeds to pay down its bank debt.
EZPET retails motor fuels through 174 locations in 14 states under its proprietary brand name, E-Z Serve, and a number of major brands including Conoco, Chevron and CITGO.

Neil McLaurin, chairman and chief executive officer, said the transactions will allow E-Z Serve Corp focus on its core business of operating convenience stores and remove a major cash flow management issue related to environmental cleanup and underground storage tank upgrade requirements.

Jack Ceccarelli, chairman and chief executive officer of Restructure, said the acquisition creates a gasoline marketing opportunity for the company, and expands the environmental business of Environment Corporation.
